title: The Cognitive Continuity Test: Verifying Governed State Transitions in Persistent AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Persistent AI agents revise beliefs, consolidate memory, and replace execution substrates. Similar successor states can accompany differently authorized transition claims, while legitimate development can change state substantially. We introduce the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying submitted transitions using scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application, semantic predicates, and candidate-persistence receipts. CCT distinguishes verified admissibility, affirmative violation, and unresolved required evidence. Separation results concern transition claims rather than live runtime identity; soundness is conditional on the specified checker and evaluator assumptions.   IdentityLineageBench provides 24 generated transition families. translated_title: 认知连续性测试：验证持久化AI智能体中的受治理状态转换
translated_abstract: 持久化AI智能体会修订信念、巩固记忆并替换执行载体。相似的后继状态可能伴随授权不同的转换声明，而合法的发展也可能使状态发生实质性改变。我们提出了认知连续性测试（CCT），这是一个相对于策略的契约，通过范围化权限、来源追溯、确定性应用、语义谓词以及候选持久化回执来验证所提交的转换。CCT区分三种结果：已验证的可接受性、确证的违规以及待补齐证据的未决状态。分离性结果针对的是转换声明而非运行时的活体身份；可靠性取决于所指定的检查器与评估器假设。IdentityLineageBench提供了24个生成的转换族。参考的事后解析验证器与全部576个规范的保留标签完全匹配；词汇状态相似度和仅基于谱系的诊断基线分别接纳60.0%和……
tldr: 提出认知连续性测试（CCT）——一个基于范围化权限、来源追溯、确定性应用等要素的策略相对契约，用于验证持久化AI智能体的状态转换声明，并在IdentityLineageBench基准上实现576个保留标签的全匹配，远超词汇相似度和仅谱系基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying state transition claims in persistent AI agents, and shows that its reference verifier matches all 576 held-out labels on IdentityLineageBench, substantially outperforming lexical similarity and lineage-only baselines.
